situations.title: 척추마취 체위 보조
situations.tagline: Can you help me curl forward? I'm scared I'll move at the wrong time.
situations.brief: 척추마취를 위해 좌위·측와위 체위를 취하도록 환자를 보조하세요.
keyPhrases: Round your back out toward me, like a shrimp.
Rest your arms on the pillow and stay still.
I'll hold your shoulders so you feel steady.
goals: 환자가 바른 척추마취 자세를 취하도록 돕는다

situations.title: 무균 준비 보조
situations.tagline: That feels cold on my back — what are you putting on me?
situations.brief: 무균 준비를 진행하며 환자에게 절차를 설명하고 안심시키세요.
keyPhrases: I'm cleaning your back with a cold antiseptic.
You'll feel cold and some pressure, but no cutting.
Try to stay still while I prep the area.

situations.title: 블록 레벨 확인
situations.tagline: It feels cold up to about my belly button — is that where it's supposed to be?
situations.brief: 감각 레벨을 확인하며 환자와 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: Tell me where the cold feels different as I move up.
Can you feel this the same on both sides?
That level looks just right for your surgery.
goals: 냉감 검사로 블록 감각 레벨을 확인한다
좌우 대칭과 레벨을 환자와 함께 점검한다

situations.title: 시술 중 활력 감시
situations.tagline: The machine keeps beeping — is something wrong with me?
situations.brief: 시술 중 활력징후를 감시하며 환자를 안심시키세요.
keyPhrases: The beeping is just the monitor tracking your numbers.
Your blood pressure and heart rate look good.
I'm watching everything closely the whole time.

situations.title: 환자 안심 소통
situations.tagline: I've never been awake for surgery before — I'm really nervous about this.
situations.brief: 척추마취로 깨어 있는 환자를 안심시키세요.
keyPhrases: It's normal to feel nervous being awake for this.
You won't feel pain, just some pressure at times.
I'll be right here talking you through it.
goals: 깨어 있는 수술에 대한 불안을 정서적으로 지지한다
통증 없이 진행됨을 설명하고 곁을 지킨다

situations.title: 국소마취제 확인
situations.tagline: Let's confirm the local — bupivacaine 0.5 percent, right dose and expiration?
situations.brief: 국소마취제 종류와 용량을 팀과 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Can we confirm the drug, concentration, and dose?
Bupivacaine 0.5 percent — is that what's drawn up?
Let's double-check the expiration together.

situations.title: 블록 레벨 상승 감시
situations.tagline: My chest feels a little tight now, and the numbness seems to be creeping up.
situations.brief: 블록 레벨이 상승하는지 감시하고 환자를 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Tell me if the numbness is moving up your chest.
Take a slow, easy breath for me — how does that feel?
I'm letting anesthesia know right away.

situations.title: 교감차단 저혈압·서맥
situations.tagline: Her pressure and heart rate are both dropping — classic sympathetic block; let's treat it.
situations.brief: 교감신경 차단에 따른 저혈압과 서맥에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Her pressure and heart rate are both falling.
Let's give fluids and have ephedrine ready.
I'll grab atropine in case the rate keeps dropping.

situations.title: 부위마취 실패 보완
situations.tagline: I can still feel sharp pain right there — the numbing didn't really work for me.
situations.brief: 부위마취가 충분치 않은 환자를 사정하고 보완 계획을 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: Show me exactly where you still feel sharp pain.
You shouldn't feel anything sharp — thank you for telling me.
I'll let anesthesia know so we can add more coverage.

situations.title: 이상 감각 신경 자극
situations.tagline: I felt a sharp zing shoot down my leg just now — is that normal?
situations.brief: 시술 중 이상 감각을 호소하는 환자를 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Tell me right away if you feel any shooting or electric feeling.
Which leg, and how far down did it go?
I'm letting the anesthesiologist know immediately.
goals: 신경 자극 가능성을 즉시 팀에 보고한다

situations.title: 배뇨 지연 감시
situations.tagline: It's been hours and I still can't pee — my lower belly feels really full.
situations.brief: 척추마취 후 요저류를 감시하고 환자를 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: It can be hard to void for a while after a spinal.
Let me check your bladder with a quick scan.
We can help empty it if it's too full.
goals: 방광 스캔과 필요 시 도뇨를 안내한다

situations.title: 항응고 척추혈종 위험
situations.tagline: She's on a DOAC — before any neuraxial block, we need to confirm the timing for hematoma risk.
situations.brief: 항응고 환자의 척추혈종 위험을 선별하고 팀과 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: When did she last take her anticoagulant?
Neuraxial anesthesia raises the risk of spinal hematoma.
Let's confirm the safe interval before proceeding.
goals: 척추혈종 위험을 선별해 팀과 안전 간격을 확인한다

situations.title: 두통 예방 소통
situations.tagline: My friend got a terrible headache after her spinal — will that happen to me?
situations.brief: 척추마취 후 두통 예방과 대처를 환자에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Post-spinal headaches are uncommon but can happen.
Tell us if you get a headache that's worse when you sit up.
Staying hydrated and resting can help.

situations.title: 진정 병용 감시
situations.tagline: I feel really drowsy now... is it okay if I just drift off a little?
situations.brief: 진정을 병용한 환자의 의식과 호흡을 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: It's okay to feel sleepy — I'm watching your breathing.
Take a nice deep breath for me now and then.
I'll wake you gently if I need you.
goals: 진정 중 의식 수준과 호흡을 감시한다

situations.title: 말초신경블록 부위 확인
situations.tagline: You're numbing my right shoulder for the surgery, correct?
situations.brief: 말초신경블록 시행 전 시술 부위를 환자와 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's confirm together — which side are we blocking?
The right shoulder, matching your surgical site?
I'll mark it and verify with the team.
goals: 블록 시행 부위를 환자와 함께 확인한다

situations.title: 전척수마취 호흡마비
situations.tagline: The block's gone way too high — she can't breathe well and her pressure's crashing.
situations.brief: 전척수마취로 호흡마비가 온 환자에게 응급 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: The block level is too high — she's struggling to breathe.
Let's support her airway and get ready to bag her.
Push fluids and pressors — I'll call for help.

situations.title: 국소마취제 전신독성
situations.tagline: She's got ringing in her ears and twitching — I think this is local anesthetic toxicity.
situations.brief: 국소마취제 전신독성(LAST)을 인지하고 응급 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: She has tinnitus and muscle twitching — I'm worried about LAST.
Let's stop the injection and get the lipid emulsion.
Call for help and prepare for possible seizures.
goals: 주입 중단과 lipid emulsion 준비를 협조한다

situations.title: 급성 서맥 심정지 위험
situations.tagline: Her heart rate just dropped into the 30s — grab atropine, we can't let this stall.
situations.brief: 급성 서맥으로 심정지 위험이 있는 환자에게 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Her heart rate is in the 30s and dropping.
Let's give atropine now and get the crash cart.
Be ready for pacing if she doesn't respond.
goals: atropine 투여와 응급 장비를 신속히 준비한다

situations.title: 척추혈종 신경 악화
situations.tagline: The numbness in my legs is getting worse and my back is really hurting now.
situations.brief: 척추혈종이 의심되는 신경 악화 환자를 사정하고 긴급 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: Tell me if the weakness is getting worse or spreading.
Can you still move your toes and feel me touch here?
I'm calling anesthesia right now — this needs quick attention.
goals: 진행하는 신경 악화와 등 통증을 사정한다

situations.title: 경련 발생 대응
situations.tagline: He's seizing — protect his head and get suction and airway ready now.
situations.brief: 경련이 발생한 환자에게 응급 처치를 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: He's seizing — let's protect his head and airway.
Get suction and oxygen ready.
I'll draw up a benzodiazepine — call for help.
goals: 경련 발생을 즉시 인지하고 기도를 보호한다

situations.title: 블록 실패 전신마취 전환
situations.tagline: So the spinal isn't working — does that mean you'll put me all the way to sleep now?
situations.brief: 부위마취 실패로 전신마취 전환이 필요한 환자에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: The spinal didn't give us enough coverage.
For your comfort and safety, we'll switch to general anesthesia.
You'll be fully asleep and won't feel anything.
goals: 부위마취 실패와 전신마취 전환의 이유를 설명한다
